hooks.text: 切、煮、烤、炸等短烹饪小游戏会把食材做成战斗生物，每轮还能新增队员或进化已有斗士。
hooks.excerpt: Chop, boil, bake and fry your ingredients into fighting shape in a snappy series of bite-sized minigames. Each round is a chance to add to your team or evolve your existing fighters into new, more powerful evolutions!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 最多6对6的回合战中，可从六十五种手绘食物斗士的能力和协同中编排组合，并加入厨师力量与调味料变化。
hooks.excerpt: Once you're plated up, command your culinary creations in up-to-6v6 turn-based battles! Cook up your own strategies and combos from 65+ lovingly hand-animated GladiEATers unique sets of abilities and synergies. Unlock Combat Chef powers and seasonings for an extra twist.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 七段关于烹饪、冲突与共情的厨师故事汇聚到CALosseum，让角色解决旧怨并建立关系。
hooks.excerpt: Seven stories of cooking, conflict, and compassion all lead to the CALosseum: A pun-flinging egg farmer, a monolingual Finnish baker (and his best friend) and at least one secret agent will prove themselves, settle old scores, and maybe even make a few friends along the way.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
